turns.replyText:
Yes. To get the best overall result from a Tediber mattress, I would prioritize three things:

A stable, supportive bed base: Tediber’s wooden bed base is compatible with all mattress types. If you use another slatted base, check that its weight capacity suits the mattress. Current Tediber mattresses are not suitable for electric or adjustable bed bases.
A mattress protector: this helps protect your investment from moisture and everyday wear. Tediber’s protector is rated 4.6/5 from 6,119 reviews and is described as waterproof and silent.
No topper by default: Tediber mattresses are designed to provide their intended comfort without one. Adding a topper may change the feel and prevent you from experiencing the mattress’s comfort layers as designed. A topper is more useful when adapting another mattress, for example to make a mattress softer or firmer.

The best pairing can still depend on the exact model and your current bed base. If you share those two details, I can check the combination more precisely.
